title: Challenge The Dungeon
paragraphs: “I’ve certainly heard about that Yuta person.”

When we inquired about the whereabouts of the Hero at the Adventurer’s Guild in the town we moved to, the guild member explained to Father that if we were looking for someone, it would be best to hire this particular person. That person was apparently named Cola, and they seemed to have quite a track record.
“It means they’re getting a lot of attention recently.”
“But… this Yuta person, their place of origin is unclear, isn’t it?”
Father is looking through the adventurer registry at the guild, checking their background.
“Do adventurers really need to have their place of origin verified?”
“Well, it’s probably easy to fake that kind of information. The Ren and Itsuki from the first world that Motoyasu talked about probably did the same.”
“That’s true. Since it’s a jack-of-all-trades job where the one who completes the task reports it, it’s easy to remain undercover.”
“Adventurer guilds range from top-notch to bottom-tier. As long as they can do the job, many places don’t care about their background.”
Éclair agrees, as if reinforcing the point. While that may be how the system works, it’s becoming a major obstacle for us.
“We can’t track the Hero, and this whole area is filled with talk about that Yuta guy.”
“The tasks they’ve accomplished are defeating dangerous monsters, conquering dungeons, and taking down bandits?”
“That’s quite an impressive record for an adventurer. It seems like they’re moving from town to town, looking for new work.”
“Should we hire that guy to search for the Hero?”
“Hmm…”

Father and the others seem hesitant to give a response to the guild member looking at them with hopeful eyes. Well, there’s plenty to be suspicious about. More than anything, this version of Father and the others are a bit wary of humans, which makes them hesitant to hire an unknown adventurer.
“Calling them over just for this seems unnecessary. Besides, they seemed distant and might refuse the request.”
“…We’re already handling the request. Why would we pass it off to someone else?”
“That’s true. But still…”
I glance over the notes detailing what we know about the projectile weapon Hero so far. The records mostly talk about when they were first summoned, but everything after that is abstract and vague.
“Isn’t there far too little information to go on?”
The eyewitness accounts and everything else disappear after just a few days from the summoning.
At this rate, how are we even supposed to search for them?
“Exactly. It’s like they’re hiding out in the mountains or something. We can’t track their movements at all.”
“Judging from the lights at the church that worships the Seven Star Hero in Faubrey, it seems like they’re still alive, though.”
“Can we really afford to spend time on this kind of needle-in-a-haystack search between waves?”
“Yeah… it’s turning out to be more difficult than I thought. Honestly, I’d rather just train Windia-chan or Rat-san and have one of them become the Whip Hero.”
“I know it’s an extreme idea, but I get how you feel.”
“Motoyasu-kun’s portal can take us to specific locations, so maybe we should seriously consider raising a compatible wielder as an alternative.”
“As for the Hammer, if I recall correctly, Sakura-san had it in the previous loop, according to Motoyasu-san.”

We’re already beginning to consider abandoning the search. Our time is limited, after all. Sure, we’ve grown strong enough that waves are hardly a concern anymore, but if we’re going to waste time endlessly searching for the projectile weapon and axe Heroes who never seem to show up, it might be more worthwhile to look for new wielders for the Seven Star weapons we took from Takt and the gauntlets whose owner has yet to be found.
“They’re still trying to summon the Seven Star Heroes in Faubrey every day, right?”
“Apparently so? But I hear they haven’t had any success.”
Father and the others heave a deep sigh. The Seven Star Heroes always give us trouble.
“Well, we still have a few more days left for investigation. Should we dive into a dungeon to help raise Sakura-chan and Windia-chan’s levels?”
Father suggested this, perhaps to change the subject.
“That might be a good idea.”
“Imiya, you’ve improved a lot lately. It might be good for you to try fighting without relying on the Heroes.”
“Indeed. You’ve become quite adept at using the shortsword I personally taught you to wield.”
“Y-Yes!”
The mole seems to have improved after all the lessons from Ren and Éclair. I can agree with Father on this.
“Windia-chan, Sakura-chan, and perhaps others who might be able to wield the hammer or gauntlets… we should also consider training people who can fight barehanded.”
“The Filolials all seem capable of mastering claws, don’t they?”
That’s what Itsuki said. He understands well. I feel quite pleased. After all, claws were the weapons that Filo-tan wielded in the first world.
“Filo-tan was chosen as the Claw Hero!”
“In that case, the Filolials will have to give it their best. We’ve grown more than strong enough, so maybe it’s time we focused on refining our techniques and mindset.”
“The real problem is that we don’t know exactly what qualifies someone as a Hero.”
“Not to echo Motoyasu-san’s words, but maybe it’s something to do with their spirit and determination to fight?”
“Who knows? Either way, if we can’t find them, we should focus on strengthening our forces before the next wave. Let’s explore dungeons or places where dangerous monsters live to level up.”
“I have no objections. But…”
Itsuki turns his gaze toward me.
“Isn’t the easiest way to check who the wielders were in previous loops?”
“According to Motoyasu-kun, most of the time when they defeated Takt, our allies were chosen as the new wielders. We should probably follow that pattern… but…”
“The problem is that Motoyasu’s stories are always so vague. It’s almost always about Filolials or Naofumi.”
Oh? Is that so? But isn’t it only natural, as part of the order of things, that there would be more stories about the Filolials and Father? As I smiled, Father and the others let out a sigh.
“In the first world, the claws were wielded by Filo-tan, the hammer by Filo-tan’s older sister, and the gauntlets were held by the Hakuko slave that Father raised, correct?”
“The claws and hammer were with the Filolials… and the gauntlets were with a slave Naofumi raised?”
Oh? It seems that Ren has misunderstood something. The hammer belonged to the older sister. I must correct this.
“Last time, wasn’t Sakura-chan the one who wielded the hammer?”
Before I could correct him, Father asked me. So, I prioritized answering Father’s question.
“Indeed. The projectile weapon was with Yuki-chan.”
“Then how about we take the Filolials to a nearby dungeon, raise their levels, and see if they can be chosen by the Seven Star weapons?”
“Fufufufu~ Gaelion will work hard and aim to become the Claw Hero too!”
Rival declared this proudly.
I won’t let that happen!
“Umm… Heroes…”
Someone who recognized the face of the projectile weapon’s Hero spoke hesitantly.
“I have no objection to level grinding, but I also want the Heroes to continue searching for the projectile weapon’s Hero.”
Éclair picked up on this and made the suggestion.

“I know, we’ll have to expand the search range eventually anyway. And we’ll need more people for that. Besides, part of Motoyasu-kun’s Filolial plan involves laying the groundwork for that, so this helps both goals.”
Father explained our thoughts. No doubt about it. The Filolials are absolutely necessary. I nodded enthusiastically.
“Then, which dungeon should we go to? Ren, Itsuki, do you know any around here?”
“Let’s see… if it’s the same as in the game…”
We looked at the map inside the guild to decide where to go.

“If we keep helping them too much, Imiya-san and Windia-san will just end up as high-level companions like Takt’s allies. It’s better if we can watch over them to a certain extent. I think this place would be good.”
Itsuki pointed to a dungeon. For us, it’s a bit of a step back.
“If we’re looking for something close by, that’s a reasonable choice. Of course, that’s assuming it’s the same as it was in the game… but this place does have a slightly higher required level.”
“That’s fine, isn’t it? They’ve had a little experience since their class upgrade.”
“We shouldn’t push them too hard, but it’s meaningless if it’s too easy. A place with an appropriate level should be good for their growth.”
“Then, let’s go!”
Just as I was about to take the lead, Father and Ren grabbed my shoulders.
What is the meaning of this?
“What’s going on?”
“Motoyasu-kun, you’re staying at the back, okay? This is about giving Windia-chan and Sakura-chan the experience they need.”
“Exactly. We planned to split into teams and tackle the dungeon in parallel.”
“Understood!”
I’ll leave all the complicated stuff to Father and the others. All I have to do is follow orders.
That way, the future belongs to us!
